Does R explain A? Yes - removing distortions is the mechanism by which productivity rises.
-> answer (a)
fact: Simple tax systems cut deadweight losses and allocation distortions, raising productivity and growth.

steps: Logic: headline CPI is a weighted average that includes food and core, so it must lie BETWEEN them - strike (b) and (d), which put headline at an extreme.
Strike (c): equal food and headline is implausible. In early 2024 food (~8-9%) was far above core (<4%).
-> answer (a) Food Inflation > Headline Inflation > Core Inflation

underline.text: Food Inflation > Headline Inflation > Core Inflation

fact: In early 2024 Indian food inflation (~8-9%) exceeded headline CPI (~5%), which exceeded core inflation (<4%).
